name: font-presets
title: Font Presets
description: Font-family based preset system with 7 starters (Montserrat, Inter, Space Grotesk, Playfair, Source Serif 4, EB Garamond, JetBrains Mono). Grouped by family (sans/serif/mono).

files.content:
{
  "id": "playfair-display",
  "label": "Playfair Display",
  "family": "serif",
  "cssVar": "var(--font-playfair), \"Playfair Display\", Georgia, \"Times New Roman\", serif",
  "category": "Classique"
}

{
  "id": "source-serif-4",
  "label": "Source Serif 4",
  "family": "serif",
  "cssVar": "var(--font-source-serif-4), \"Source Serif 4\", Georgia, \"Times New Roman\", serif",
  "category": "Classique"
}

{
  "id": "eb-garamond",
  "label": "EB Garamond",
  "family": "serif",
  "cssVar": "var(--font-eb-garamond), \"EB Garamond\", Georgia, \"Times New Roman\", serif",
  "category": "Classique"
}

{
  "id": "jetbrains-mono",
  "label": "JetBrains Mono",
  "family": "mono",
  "cssVar": "var(--font-jetbrains-mono), \"JetBrains Mono\", ui-monospace, \"SF Mono\", \"Cascadia Code\", \"Source Code Pro\", Menlo, Consolas, monospace",
  "category": "Mono"
}
